description: Will this Solana transfer succeed? A verdict for SOL or an SPL or Token-2022 token. When to use: Before building or signing a Solana transfer, to learn whether it will fail and what it will cost in rent and fees. Prefer another tool: Not a simulation of the exact transaction (no priority fee, no program logic), not a token price or holder lookup, and not a way to read raw accounts. Example: solana_transfer_readiness {"source":"83astBRguLMdt2h5U1Tpdq5tjFoJ6noeGwaY3mDLVcri","destination":"A1TMhSGzQxMr1TboBKtgixKz1sS6REASMxPo1qsyTSJd","mint":"SOL","amount":"0.5"}

amount.description: Positive decimal amount in UI units (SOL or tokens, not lamports or raw units); at most 18446744073709551615 in raw units

destination.description: Receiving wallet (not its token account), different from source: Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes

mint.description: `SOL` for native SOL, or the mint address of an SPL Token or Token-2022 token

source.description: Sending wallet: Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes

name: solana_transfer_readiness

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time

as_of.description: When we read the data from Solana (our read time)

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

commitment.description: Every read is at finalized commitment

slot.description: Lowest context slot of the finalized reads behind the answer; null when none of them carries one, never 0

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

amount.description: Amount checked, in display units of the asset (SOL, or the token at the mint's decimals); on `/v1/solana/transfer-readiness` the request's `amount`, as sent

amount_atomic.description: Amount checked, in base units of the asset (lamports for SOL)

ata_creation_lamports.description: Lamports to create the destination token account: its rent-exempt minimum, or only the shortfall when its address already holds SOL; null when not needed

checks_failed.description: Checks that could not run: a source or destination token account that exists but cannot be decoded, so its memo and confidential-credit state is unknown; empty when every account decoded

decimals.description: Decimals of the asset (9 for SOL)

destination_kind.description: Class of the destination account: not_found, wallet, nonce, token_account, mint, token_multisig, program, stake, vote or other

destination_token_account.description: The destination's associated token account for the mint, the account the transfer credits: the derived address also when it must be created (`requires_ata_creation`) or holds another program's account (`destination_ata_occupied`); null for SOL

interest_rate_pct.description: InterestBearingConfig current rate in percent (its basis points / 100, exact; negative for a negative rate; display only); null without that extension

net_amount_atomic.description: Base units of the asset the destination receives after any transfer fee

reasons.description: Every blocking reason code that matched

requires_ata_creation.description: True when the destination has no associated token account yet

value.description: Balance in display units of the asset (`value_atomic` / 10^`decimals`, exact)

value_atomic.description: Balance in base units of the asset (lamports for SOL)

source_balance.description: The source's balance of the asset, which `insufficient_balance` compares: the source token account's amount, or the source's lamports for SOL; zero when the source has no token account of the mint; for a source token account that cannot be decoded (`checks_failed`), its base-layout amount, or null when the account is shorter than the 165-byte base

source_token_account.description: The source's associated token account for the mint, the account the transfer debits; null for SOL

token_program.description: Token program that owns the mint; null for SOL

transfer_fee_atomic.description: Token-2022 transfer fee in base units of the mint; null without a fee config

epoch.description: Epoch from which the newer fee applies

transfer_fee_max.description: Newer maximum fee per transfer in display units of the mint (raw / 10^decimals, exact)

transfer_fee_pct.description: Newer transfer fee in percent (basis points / 100)

transfer_fee_next.description: Newer transfer fee when its epoch is after the current epoch; null otherwise

ui_multiplier.description: ScaledUiAmount multiplier in effect at response time, the factor a wallet applies to the display amount, as a plain decimal string (display only, never used in amount math); null without ScaledUiAmount

verdict.description: `not_ready` on any blocking reason; else `unknown` on any failed check; else `ready`

title: Solana transfer readiness
